Earlier in May, OpenAI launched a dedicated version of its mobile app for enterprise users, and now SpaceXAI is also rolling out a similar enterprise edition for Grok.

Grok for Intune is now available

This enterprise-exclusive app is called Grok for Intune. SpaceXAI stated that this dedicated application is "the Microsoft Intune version of Grok (xAI's AI assistant), designed specifically for organisations using Intune to manage apps and data."

The company noted: "It supports Intune mobile application management, complies with enterprise app protection policies, and allows sign-in using a corporate email account."

SpaceXAI highlighted the following features of Grok for Intune:

AI Assistant: Get quick answers to any question, conduct in-depth research online, or tackle challenging problems in math, science and coding. Upload files and photos, or paste links for Grok to analyse and explain. Grok Imagine: Generate stunning images from simple text prompts, or upload images for Grok to edit — remove objects, change scenes, or apply any artistic style. Create short videos with sound effects using text prompts, or turn static photos into videos. Voice Mode: Hands-free conversation with Grok, receiving natural voice replies. Live Camera: Share what you're seeing in front of you, and let Grok analyse and reason about it in real time. Real-Time Information: With access to the web and X's data, Grok's answers stay up to date with the latest news, trends and developments on every topic. Built for Managed Devices: Deployed and configured by your IT team through Microsoft Intune. Complies with enterprise app protection policies, including restrictions on storage, sharing and data transfer. Sign in with a corporate email account. No in-app purchases.

Grok for Intune is now available on the App Store.
